verdict.summary: The fallback is narrowly triggered only by tableau ResourceBudget exhaustion, reuses the existing guarded RL/EL consistency branches, rejects transitive and out-of-profile augmentations, and fails closed if the rendered structural ontology does not round-trip to the same axiom multiset. The integration tests exercise both definitive RL outcomes on the real entailment path and pin the principal refusal cases (out-of-profile and RL divergence), while focused unit tests cover EL abstention, transitivity refusal, and the round-trip comparison. Branch attribution and preservation of the original ResourceBudget abstention are consistent with the documented semantics. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue requiring changes was found.
